title: The Gravity of New Lagos Anew
author: Yara Eastwick
blurb: Noor Yarrow, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
